## Load Data

```{r}
#| label: libraries
#| echo: FALSE

if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("BiocManager")}

BiocManager::install("GEOquery")

library(GEOquery)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| label: load data from GSE-website

GSE24504_raw <- getGEO("GSE24504", GSEMatrix = TRUE, getGPL = TRUE)[[1]]
dim(GSE24504_raw)

write.table(x = GSE24504_raw, file = "../_raw/GSE24504_raw", sep = "\t")
```
